name: Save Artifact
description: Save a file to this agent's durable artifacts directory for later retrieval and UI browse/download.

function.name: save_artifact
function.description: Save lasting outputs (reports, exports, images, PDFs) into this chat session's artifacts store. Prefer after producing files the user may want later in this conversation. Use source_path for existing files; content for UTF-8 text. Files are served at /api/sessions/<session-id>/artifacts/<filename>.

filename.description: Basename only (e.g. report.md, chart.png). No path separators.

content.description: UTF-8 text to write. Ignored if source_path is set.

source_path.description: Existing file path under the workplace, or workplace_id:path, or /_portal/name/....
